title: Auxiliary uniform-excess contraction bound
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ with a nonempty vertex set, and suppose that $G$ is connected and nonbipartite. Then $|V|/D^{2|V|}\le 1$, and every rational-valued function $p$ on the vertices whose values sum to $1$ satisfies: after $2|V|$ steps, its distribution has uniform excess at most $\left(1-|V|/D^{2|V|}\right)$ times the uniform excess of $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ has a finite, nonempty vertex set
$G$ is a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
